fact: The World Bank says the AMEN programme's management information system has been strengthened, speeding the beneficiary application process and eligibility verification.

The World Bank says the AMEN management information system is being enhanced, including interoperability with other agencies' databases, and a case management system is being established with UNDP under the SPLA project.
The World Bank says 44.4% of AMEN cash transfers are digitalised, with a convention between the Ministry of Social Affairs and the Tunisian Post for digital payment cards tied to an e-wallet.
